title: Toy car
about: Tutorial 10's car: a body with two axle holes, two axles that turn in them on revolute joints (flipped into the holes, 7 mm out), and four wheels held on the axle ends by rigid joints.
commands: run --open Body.sb --save Body.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=1.75 height=40 base=15,0,5 axis=0,1,0 name=FrontHole
run --open Body.sb --save Body.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=1.75 height=40 base=65,0,5 axis=0,1,0 name=BackHole
run --open Body.sb --save Body.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Chassis b=FrontHole name=Front
run --open Body.sb --save Body.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Front b=BackHole name=Body
run --save Axle.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=1.5 height=54 name=Axle
run --save Wheel.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=12 height=6 name=Tire
run --open Wheel.sb --save Wheel.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=1.5 height=6 name=AxleHole
run --open Wheel.sb --save Wheel.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Tire b=AxleHole name=Wheel
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb component.insert file=Axle.sb count=2 at=0,60,0 step=20,0,0
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb component.insert file=Wheel.sb count=4 at=0,-40,0 step=30,0,0
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Body 1:edge:6" "b=Axle 1:edge:1" flip=true offset=7 name=FrontAxle
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Body 1:edge:7" "b=Axle 2:edge:1" flip=true offset=7 name=BackAxle
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb joint.add kind=rigid "a=Axle 1:edge:1" "b=Wheel 1:edge:1" flip=true
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb joint.add kind=rigid "a=Axle 1:edge:3" "b=Wheel 2:edge:1" flip=true
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb joint.add kind=rigid "a=Axle 2:edge:1" "b=Wheel 3:edge:1" flip=true
run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb joint.add kind=rigid "a=Axle 2:edge:3" "b=Wheel 4:edge:1" flip=true

change.command: run --open Car.sb --save Car.sb joint.set joint=FrontAxle value=50
change.about: turn the front axle 50 degrees: its wheels turn with it, about the axle, and stay where they are.
